additional_contraction_definition: CZ hull strictly narrower than B0 on both raw resolutions; equality gives no credit
topology_rule: Equal ordered range component counts with paired endpoint changes <=0.5 km; equal face-connected joint broad component counts; bijective overlaps between coarse and fine broad components, no disappearance or merge. Outer-support topology at frozen resolution only.
primary_pass: 21/21 all conditions on both raw resolutions; retention independently evaluated after seal
scope: synthetic matched M0 static-nuisance coarse acquisition only; not real UUV, drift, SSP, continuous depth, final <10% or RC3 capture
